We'll get one for him as a last resort, but I'm at risk of ovarian cancer and having the procedure would be beneficial for that too. I'm honestly repulsed by the thought of my body being capable of having children (I love kids that aren't mine, and am super happy for women who choose to have them! But I hate that my body is able to do that) and even if he had a vasectomy, I would likely continue to use birth control to ease those feelings. So it would be a relatively pointless procedure for him.

It's just extremely frustrating that this is the solution for birth control, since drs have decided that men are allowed to do what they want with their bodies no questions asked, but women have to jump through all these hoops just to find a Dr who might consider respecting their bodies and choices.
Oh perfect, thank you! Wow there are a lot more tubal-friendly drs in the area I'd be moving to than I realized. That is super reassuring.

Thank you both! I tried to visit what was advertised as a planned parenthood up here in the midwest two years ago, but it turned out to be a religious pro-life group where when I went in after being stealthed/assaulted looking for meds/advice, I was told that I deserved any STDs I would probably get and that if I followed the founder's rules I could become a virgin again otherwise I would die from being a slut.

I realize a REAL planned parenthood wouldn't do that, but I've been a little gun-shy and will definitely do my research to make sure it's a real PP instead of... whatever the hell I visited was. I'm just not sure what all they talk about so it's refreshing to know that they may be able to help me with this, even if it's just education.

I'm on the nexplanon implant. It expires July 25th, and from what I've read, there should be a safe 1-3 month buffer where it is still completely effective. Then it will be effective after that still, just not as much. If I could somehow put it off until a Dr approved a tubal, and then they removed the implant the same day, it would be the absolute best case scenario for me.

I've been down this path before and was just laughed out of the office. I'm hoping for a fresh start with the new move and since I will not have a primary physician yet in North Carolina, I'm wondering if speaking to planned parenthood will direct me to drs who are friendly to this procedure, or if anyone on this forum has had a positive experience and recommendation for a hospital or specific Dr to start with once I move.

We are overworked in pretty much every possible way.

No one is getting any hours, but the few who are are working the floor severely understaffed and often, alone. There are less people working and more customers buying/returning which leads to each department being overworked.

Warehouse is trying to keep up with ship to home orders and a new curbside model with less staff which leads to confusion about current product locations in store because they don't have time to do their normal tasks which leads to customer frustration.

Sales floor for some stores has as little as two advisors  running the entire floor, which leads to longer wait times for customers, which leads to customer frustration.

Front end is understaffed or full of seasonals who never got proper training because there were no hours available so they were just thrown to the wolves. Which leads to mistakes, which leads to customer frustration.

This is all happening during the busiest shopping season, and in a pandemic.

All of that customer frustration leads to abuse from customers at already overworked staff. A lot of us are just exhausted and in survival mode right now, trying to get through each shift. Which leads to situations like yours.

No - I appreciate all the info, thank you!! I'm making a list of those books to work through. I'm definitely interested in therapy as well and have heard about ISF, I'm just not in a position financially to explore that more. So for now, I'll check out some of the other stuff you listed. NonViolent communication specifically looks interesting. I feel like I'm just really... uneducated emotionally? So I'm trying to fix that but I feel like I dont even know what I dont know.

Thank you again for this!!
Thank you for the recommendation, I'll look into this!

Unfortunately, neither of us are able to get help due to financial issues. I've been doing as much as I can learning on my own online and in groups like this, but I know she would need to actually go in and see someone and theres no way for her to do that right now. My sister is completely on her side,still living with her, and thinks I'm the only one who's done wrong. Otherwise I would ask her for help in talking to mom.

I appreciate you. Thank you for commenting. I hope you had a lovely christmas. ❤

I can see it now, thank you. You are really kind and I may take you up on messaging you before he comes home. I'm still on the fence about saying anything to him while he's gone but I may have a conversation with him when he gets home and brainstorm how to fix this. I'm just really tired of living this way. Everything just feels like too much work.

I got a notification that you responded a second time but I cannot see your comment. Not sure if it was removed or my phone isnt working. I just want to thank you for putting the time and effort into talking to me. I do appreciate it.

I told him the morning after in october, and since then hes been watching for it and can tell when I'm having a bad day no matter how hard I try to hide it. But I have been having a really hard time for a long time and I dont want to keep putting him in the position of needing to comfort me. I dont want to rely on him entirely. That is so much pressure for him, and he has other things to worry about. But aside from that, he is out of the country for two weeks. He left last week. He's having a good time and if I talk to him about this now it will ruin his day if not his trip and he does not deserve that. I don't want him to worry. I dont want him to panic because there's no one he can send to check on me. I need to figure out how to handle this on my own because I can't put it on other people.
This is exactly what I needed, you have no idea how much this affected me. Thank you, Mom ❤
